verdict.rationale: Penpot supports natural-language operation only through its official, agent-agnostic MCP server: you bring your own AI agent or LLM, connect it to Penpot MCP and "prompt away" to generate editable designs and automate tasks. There is no evidence of a built-in natural-language command interface in the product itself, so the story depends on external tooling. Missing for 10: a native in-app natural-language command surface, documentation of which operations can be driven by prompts, and independent or hands-on corroboration that prompt-driven operation works reliably.
